title: Agent: retry received attachments whose fetch failed
description: AgentChat::sync (sync.rs fetch_attachments) leaves out a received attachment whose fetch through the user's server fails, reports it in SyncReport.problems, and acknowledges the message, so a transient failure (server or peer hub down) loses the attachment for good although the ExternalPart (url, key, nonce, hash) was received. Keep the ExternalPart of a failed fetch (e.g. in the Message's extra properties or a side table in chat.json, never logged) and retry on later syncs until it succeeds, is refused for good (hash mismatch, 404), or expires.
